mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing risk appetite.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not positively correlated with low FEDFUNDS levels, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which may lead to negative equity returns as it reflects broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp, or if the mechanism fails to predict negative returns in 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth and housing starts jointly indicate economic expansion, which should drive positive equity returns as corporate earnings are likely to improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 0.5% yoy and HOUST increases > 5% yoy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST meet their respective growth thresholds, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth in a late-cycle expansion signals strong economic activity, leading to positive equity returns as companies maintain profitability.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative during periods of high GDPC1 growth in late-cycle expansion, or if the mechanism fails to predict positive returns in 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth indicates increased economic activity, which should lead to positive equity returns as supply chains operate efficiently and meet demand.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO growth, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to positive equity returns as consumer spending and business activity increase.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative when PAYEMS increases by more than 50k, or if the mechanism fails to predict positive returns in 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising consumer prices and falling federal funds rates may indicate inflationary pressures met with monetary easing, leading to negative equity returns due to uncertainty.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% mom and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% mom
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS meet their respective thresholds, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Real estate investment growth in an early-cycle expansion signals economic recovery, leading to positive equity returns as construction and related industries benefit.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative during periods of high RSAFS growth in early-cycle expansion, or if the mechanism fails to predict positive returns in 60% of such cases.
